source: Even though minorities of the striosomal neurons were pulse-labeled by the single tamoxifen injections, and despite the fact that there were scattered birthdate-labeled neurons in the extra-striosomal matrix at the striatal levels examined (ca. 15% of tdTomato-positive neurons), we could readily identify striosomes visually in vivo using 2-photon microscopy and could confirm this identification in post-mortem MOR1-counterstained sections prepared to assess the selectivity of labeling.
evidence: This describes the methodological achievement and validation of the approach.

claim: The time of induction used was at the middle of the striosomal neurogenic window and was before the onset of major levels of matrix neuron neurogenesis in the striatal regions imaged.
source: We are aware that, with the use of pulse-labeling at neurogenic time points, we have incomplete labeling of compartments in any one animal, but the time of induction that we used was at the middle of the striosomal neurogenic window and was before the onset of major levels of matrix neuron neurogenesis in the striatal regions imaged (Fishell and van der Kooy, 1987; Graybiel, 1984; Graybiel and Hickey, 1982; Hagimoto et al., 2017; Kelly et al., 2017; Newman et al., 2015).
evidence: This describes the rationale for the timing of tamoxifen induction, supported by citations to previous research on neurogenesis timing.

claim: The matrix compartment itself is heterogeneous, as it is composed of many input-output matrisome modules.
source: We are also aware that the matrix compartment itself is heterogeneous, as it is composed of many input-output matrisome modules (e.g., Eblen and Graybiel, 1995; Flaherty and Graybiel, 1994), but such heterogeneity could not be taken into account in our experiments.
evidence: This is a limitation acknowledged by the authors, supported by citations to previous research.

claim: The method did not rely on a single molecular or genetic marker to distinguish compartmental identity.
source: Our method did not rely on a single molecular or genetic marker to distinguish compartmental identify, but this feature had also a possible advantage in thereby avoiding potential unidentified biases that could arise from molecular-identity labeling.
evidence: This describes a feature of the methodological approach and its potential advantage.

claim: It is currently unknown to what extent there are different subtypes of striosomal neurons and what the exact neuronal subtype composition of striosomes is.
source: It is currently unknown to what extent there are different subtypes of striosomal neurons and what the exact neuronal subtype composition of striosomes is.
evidence: This statement reflects the current state of knowledge in the field.

claim: At E11.5, the time chosen for tamoxifen induction, neurons expressing D1 dopamine receptors (D1Rs) and those expressing D2 dopamine receptors (D2Rs) are both being born, with a bias toward D1 neurons.
source: Kelly et al., 2017 have found that at E11.5, the time chosen for our tamoxifen induction, neurons expressing D1 dopamine receptors (D1Rs) and those expressing D2 dopamine receptors (D2Rs) are both being born, with a bias toward D1 neurons.
evidence: This statement is supported by a citation to previous research.

claim: Other evidence suggests a predominance of D1R-containing neurons in striosomal mouse models.
source: Other evidence suggests a predominance of D1R-containing neurons in striosomal mouse models (Banghart et al., 2015; Cui et al., 2014; Smith et al., 2016) or, contrarily, a larger amount of D2R-containing neurons (Salinas et al., 2016).
evidence: This statement is supported by citations to previous research showing conflicting findings.

claim: It is likely that differential labeling of subtypes of striosomal and matrix neurons occurs in different mouse lines and in different regions of the striatum.
source: It is likely that differential labeling of subtypes of striosomal and matrix neurons occurs in different mouse lines, as has been seen by ourselves (Crittenden and Graybiel, in prep.), and in different regions of the striatum.
evidence: This is a conclusion drawn from observations in the field, including unpublished work.

claim: The findings are confined to the analysis of a very simple task, and they are unlikely to have uncovered the range of functions of the striosome and matrix compartments.
source: Our findings are confined to the analysis of a very simple task, and they clearly are unlikely to have uncovered the range of functions of the striosome and matrix compartments.
evidence: This is a limitation acknowledged by the authors regarding the scope of the study.

claim: The experiments demonstrate the feasibility of definitively identifying striosomes by 2-photon imaging as mice perform tasks.
source: Yet the experiments do demonstrate the feasibility of definitively identifying striosomes by 2-photon imaging as mice perform tasks, and of examining the activity of striosomal neurons relative to the activity of simultaneously imaged neurons in the nearly matrix.
evidence: This is a conclusion about the methodological achievement of the study.

claim: The different emphases on reward prediction and reward history detected suggest that striosomal neurons could be more responsive to the immediate contingencies of events than nearby matrix neurons.
source: The different emphases on reward prediction and reward history that we detected, however, already suggest that striosomal neurons could be more responsive to the immediate contingencies of events than nearby matrix neurons, that they could gain this enhanced sensitivity by virtue of learning-related plasticity, but that they could be less sensitive to immediately prior reward history.
evidence: This is a speculative interpretation of the findings.

claim: Striosomal neurons could gain enhanced sensitivity by virtue of learning-related plasticity.
source: The different emphases on reward prediction and reward history that we detected, however, already suggest that striosomal neurons could be more responsive to the immediate contingencies of events than nearby matrix neurons, that they could gain this enhanced sensitivity by virtue of learning-related plasticity, but that they could be less sensitive to immediately prior reward history.
evidence: This is a speculative interpretation of the findings.

claim: These attributes of the striosomes could be related to real-time direction of action plans based on real-time estimates of value.
source: These attributes of the striosomes could be related to real-time direction of action plans based on real-time estimates of value.
evidence: This is a speculative interpretation of the findings.

claim: This is the first report of simultaneous recording of visually identified striosome and matrix compartments in the striatum.
source: To our best knowledge, this is the first report of simultaneous recording of visually identified striosome and matrix compartments in the striatum, here made possible by the neuropil labeling in pulse-labeled Mash1-CreER mice.
evidence: This is a claim about the novelty of the methodological approach.

claim: Future refinements of such imaging should help to define the functional correlates of the striosome-matrix organization of the striatum.
source: Future refinements of such imaging should help to define the functional correlates of the striosome-matrix organization of the striatum.
evidence: This is a statement about the potential of the method for future research.
